docs.text:
# Merrow Harbor Dredging & Benthic Ecology

## 1. Introduction
Merrow Harbor has supported commercial maritime navigation since 1892. Recent hydrodynamic models indicate accelerated siltation along the northern navigational channel requiring periodic maintenance.

## 2. Methods & Sediment Coring
Vibracore sediment samples were extracted at thirty-two stations across a 400-hectare grid, spanning depths from 4.2 to 18.5 meters below mean lower low water (MLLW). Grain size distributions were classified using standard sieve analysis.

## 3. Results & Dredging Impact
Turbidity plumes dissipated within 4.8 hours post-suction dredging. Benthic polychaete densities exhibited an initial 42% decline within 50 meters of the dredging footprint but recovered to baseline densities within seven months.

## 4. Discussion & Tidal Recovery
Strong semidiurnal tidal flushing accelerates natural benthic substrate re-equilibration. Controlled dredging windows mitigate adverse impacts during critical larval settlement stages.

docs.text:
# Kelp Farming and Marine Nutrient Cycling

## 1. Introduction
Macroalgal mariculture offers sustainable coastal bioremediation potential alongside valuable biomass production for bioplastics and biofuels.

## 2. Nitrogen Assimilation
Saccharina latissima lines sequestered dissolved inorganic nitrogen at an average rate of 1.42 grams of nitrogen per kilogram dry weight per day during peak spring growth.

## 3. Canopy Biomass & Yields
Harvest yields reached 18.6 metric tons fresh weight per hectare. Vertical array spacing optimized light penetration across stratified water layers without inducing self-shading canopy decay.

docs.text:
# Tidal Energy Systems & Hydrodynamic Flow Optimization

## 1. Hydrodynamic Principles
Horizontal-axis tidal turbines extract kinetic energy from bidirectional astronomical tidal flows without requiring impoundment barrages or hydrological dams.

## 2. Turbine Array Spacing
Staggered turbine farm layouts with seven-rotor-diameter streamwise separation preserved 84% of upstream kinetic energy flux compared to co-axial inline configurations.

## 3. Power Grid Integration
Subsea power collection hubs utilize high-voltage direct current (HVDC) conversion, minimizing transmission losses across offshore channels to terrestrial distribution substations.
